A clinch-heavy boxing style—think Roberto Durán, Ricky Hatton, or Shawn Porter—places brutal demands on specific tissues that standard boxing conditioning often misses. Winning in the pocket requires isometric grip and forearm endurance, anti-rotation and lateral core stiffness (to win head position and frame off opponents), neck resilience (to absorb collar ties and uppercuts), and alactic-anaerobic repeatability (explosive bursts out of breaks without gassing).
This 3-week mesocycle uses an undulating block structure (Accumulation → Intensification → Peak/Realization) paired with a 3-day-per-week lifting split so you still have the recovery capacity for heavy sparring and bag work.
Weekly Schedule Overview
 * Monday: Upper Body Push/Pull & Clinch Isometrics (Strength & Grip)
 * Wednesday: Lower Body Power, Neck & Anti-Rotation Core
 * Friday: Full-Body Alactic Power & Glycolytic Conditioning
 * Tue/Thu/Sat: Boxing skill work, sparring, and low-intensity aerobic roadwork (Zone 2, 30–45 mins).
 * Sunday: Complete rest.
Week 1: Accumulation (Tissue Prep & Isometric Base)
Focus: Building tendon tolerance, baseline isometric grip/frame endurance, and controlled eccentric strength. Leave 2 reps in reserve (RIR 2) on all main lifts.
Monday — Upper Strength & Frame Endurance
 * 1A. Neutral-Grip Floor Press or Swiss Bar Bench: 4 sets × 6 reps (2-sec pause on chest/floor; mimics short-range punching power)
 * 1B. Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row: 4 sets × 8 reps (pull to lower ribs, hold 1 sec at top)
 * 2A. Heavy Towel Pull-Ups (or Fat-Grip Lat Pulldown): 3 sets × max reps (stop 1 rep before grip fails)
 * 2B. Landmine Single-Arm Press: 3 sets × 8 reps/side (staggered stance, brace hard against rotation)
 * 3. Clinch Finisher (3 Rounds, 60s rest):
   * Heavy Sandbag Bear-Hug Hold: 30 sec
   * Plate Pinch Hold (two 10kg/25lb plates smooth-side out): 20 sec/hand
   * Banded Neck Isometric Holds (Front, Back, Left, Right): 15 sec/direction
Wednesday — Lower Power, Neck & Core Stiffness
 * 1. Trap Bar Deadlift: 4 sets × 5 reps (explosive concentric, reset each rep)
 * 2A. Bulgarian Split Squat: 3 sets × 6 reps/leg (3-sec eccentric)
 * 2B. Pallof Press with 3-Sec Isometric Hold: 3 sets × 8 reps/side
 * 3A. Zercher Carry: 3 sets × 30 meters (keep elbows tight to ribs—directly transfers to underhooks)
 * 3B. Copenhagen Plank: 3 sets × 20 sec/side (adductor strength for inside-foot positioning)
 * 4. Neck Harness or Manual Resistance: 3 sets × 15 reps (flexion & extension, controlled tempo)
Friday — Rotational Explosiveness & Pocket Conditioning
 * 1A. Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop Toss: 4 sets × 5 reps/side (throw against wall as hard as possible, full reset)
 * 1B. Plyo Push-Ups (Hands leaving floor): 4 sets × 5 reps
 * 2. Kettlebell Clean & Press (Single Arm): 3 sets × 6 reps/side
 * 3. "Inside Fighting" Conditioning (Assault Bike or Heavy Bag):
   * 6 rounds of: 15 sec all-out sprint/flurry → 45 sec active shadowboxing/recovery. Rest 2 minutes, then repeat for a second block of 6 rounds.
Week 2: Intensification (Max Force & Heavy Clinch Overload)
Focus: Increasing load, reducing reps, and introducing yielding/overcoming isometrics to mimic fighting off a heavier opponent.
Monday — Upper Strength & Frame Endurance
 * 1A. Weighted Neutral-Grip Pull-Ups: 4 sets × 4–5 reps
 * 1B. Incline Dumbbell Bench Press: 4 sets × 5 reps (heavy, RIR 1–2)
 * 2A. Single-Arm Cable or Band Row (Split Stance): 3 sets × 6 reps/side (explosive pull, 3-sec return)
 * 2B. Z-Press (Seated on floor, legs straight): 3 sets × 6 reps (forces pure trunk stability)
 * 3. Clinch Finisher (4 Rounds, 60s rest):
   * Partner/Strap Collar-Tie Isometric Pull-Down: 20 sec max effort
   * Heavy Farmer’s Walk (Fat Grips if available): 25 meters
   * Banded Neck Isometric Holds: 20 sec/direction
Wednesday — Lower Power, Neck & Core Stiffness
 * 1. Trap Bar Deadlift: 4 sets × 3 reps (85–88% 1RM, crisp bar speed)
 * 2A. Barbell Zercher Squat (or Heavy Goblet Squat): 3 sets × 5 reps
 * 2B. Heavy Suitcase Carry: 3 sets × 25 meters/side (do not let torso lean)
 * 3A. Landmine Rotations (Russian Twist standing): 3 sets × 6 reps/side (explosive pivot)
 * 3B. Hanging Knee/Leg Raises: 3 sets × 10 reps
 * 4. Neck Harness / Plate Neck Curls: 3 sets × 12 reps (heavier load than Week 1)
Friday — Rotational Explosiveness & Pocket Conditioning
 * 1A. Med Ball Overhead Slam (Max Velocity): 4 sets × 5 reps
 * 1B. Band-Resisted Shadowboxing Punches (Hooks/Uppercuts): 4 sets × 8 sec max speed/side
 * 2. Heavy Sandbag Shouldering: 3 sets × 4 reps/side (explosive hip drive)
 * 3. "Championship Rounds" Conditioning (3-Minute Boxing Rounds):
   * 3 Rounds × 3 min (1 min rest):
     * 0:00–0:30: Heavy Bag short-range hooks & uppercuts (80% effort)
     * 0:30–1:00: Heavy Sandbag Bear-Hug Squat or Isometric Hold
     * 1:00–2:00: Hard Heavy Bag work (non-stop volume)
     * 2:00–2:30: Sprawls / Burpees (6–8 reps)
     * 2:30–3:00: All-out bag sprint
Week 3: Realization / Peak (Speed-Strength & Taper)
Focus: Drop total lifting volume by ~35–40% while keeping intensity high. You should finish every session feeling faster, springier, and primed for fight week or peak sparring.
Monday — Upper Speed-Strength
 * 1A. Speed Floor Press (60% 1RM): 4 sets × 3 reps (move the bar as fast as possible)
 * 1B. Explosive Chest-Supported Row: 4 sets × 4 reps
 * 2A. Half-Kneeling Landmine Press: 2 sets × 5 reps/side (explosive)
 * 2B. Fat-Grip Dead Hang: 2 sets × 30 sec
 * 3. Neck Activation: 2 sets × 10 sec isometric holds/direction (light tension, no soreness)
Wednesday — Lower Ballistics & Core
 * 1. Trap Bar Jump Squats (Light: 25–30% 1RM): 4 sets × 3 reps (reset completely between jumps)
 * 2A. Reverse Lunges (Bodyweight or light DBs): 2 sets × 5 reps/leg
 * 2B. Pallof Press (Explosive punch-out): 2 sets × 6 reps/side
 * 3. Zercher Carry (Moderate weight, brisk pace): 2 sets × 20 meters
Friday — Alactic Sharpness (Flush & Prime)
 * 1. Med Ball Rotational Chest Pass: 3 sets × 4 reps/side (full recovery between sets)
 * 2. Banded Hooks/Uppercuts: 3 sets × 6 sec max velocity/side
 * 3. Alactic Sprint Intervals (Bike or Rower):
   * 5 rounds of: 10 sec 100% effort → 50 sec complete rest. Stop while power output is still at its peak.
Key Coaching Cues for Inside Fighters
 * Protect your wrists and thumbs: When doing heavy towel pulls, plate pinches, or sandbag holds, stop the set the moment your wrist starts buckling into flexion. Boxers cannot afford bruised or strained metacarpals.
 * Breathe behind the shield: During isometric holds (Zercher carries, bear hugs, planks), practice taking short, sharp nasal breaths while keeping your abs braced—exactly how you need to breathe when trapped on the ropes.
